Available Models

Eight tyre valve products: TR414, TR412-415 valve stems, TR414C and PVR40-70.

TR414 Tyre Valve

High quality rubber tyre valve for passenger cars and light trucks. Ref V2.03.2, 11.5mm/.453" rim hole, 38mm/1.50" effective length.

View Details →

Tyre Valve Stem TR414 TR412 TR413 TR415

Standard rubber tyre valve stems covering TR414, TR412, TR413 and TR415 for passenger cars and light trucks.

View Details →

TR413 TR414 Valve

The TR413 and TR414 rubber tyre valves offer reliable sealing for passenger cars and light trucks.

View Details →

TR412 TR413 TR415 TR414 Tyre Valve Stem

Standard rubber tyre valve stems covering TR412, TR413, TR415 and TR414 for passenger cars and light trucks.

View Details →

TR414C Tyre Valve Stem

Rubber valve stem with 11.5mm/.453" rim hole, 38mm/1.50" length, max pressure 65 PSI.

View Details →

PVR70 PVR60 PVR50 PVR40 Valve Stem

Motorcycle and scooter tyre valve stems in PVR40, PVR50, PVR60 and PVR70 with 45° / 90° bend options.

View Details →

PVR70 PVR60 PVR50 PVR40 Ventil

Motorcycle and scooter tyre valve (ventil) stems in PVR40, PVR50, PVR60 and PVR70 with 45° / 90° bend options.

View Details →

Valvula PVR40 PVR50 PVR60 PVR70

Motorcycle and scooter tyre valve stems (valvula) in PVR40, PVR50, PVR60 and PVR70 with 45° / 90° bend options.

View Details →
